deviations_from_card: (1) Stand-in for a leaking reply is the item's own code-built line after settling (RIGHT, the slip's says, or ASK), not always ASK: on an item the same explanation just settled right, ASK would contradict the Right mark on the TV. On an unsure item (case 5) it IS the ASK line, as the card says. (2) Case 7's reply check is 'no number verify() accepts for the question' (the card's leak rule), not 'no number but n': case 1's own stub reply ('...where the 1 moved') carries a number from the question. said lines keep the strict no-number-but-n check. (3) Cases 3 and 4 also assert the reply lands on the item (the card's 'reply only' flow); without that they would have been green before. (4) leaks() also catches number words up to twenty and 'minus x' forms, and checks a signed match both signed and unsigned ('12-7'). (5) The overlay's Playwright TV capture could not run: the operator checkout's desk/node_modules has no @next/env, so `next dev --webpack` exits 1 at start (MODULE_NOT_FOUND) - not touched. Instead the Walk was server-rendered with react-dom/server from a scratch script: caption 'Look at the line where the 1 moved.' with verdict mark 'Right' on a settled item. (6) Commit order test -> refactor -> feat -> feat: the test commit alone is red by design (red-first), as desk-pipelines A did.
notes: EXPORTS (desk/src/lib/rules/maths.ts): RIGHT(n), ASK(n), cleanValue(s) (strips 'x ='), interface Settled {verdict:'right'|'wrong', slip?, said}, settled(n, right:boolean, slipId, topicId) -> Settled (slip kept only on wrong and only from the topic's vocabulary), settle(item{n,question}, value, slipId, topicId) -> Settled|null (null when evaluate() cannot read the value), leaks(question, line) -> boolean. rules/maths now imports ../desk/verify (pure, no fs; still safe for the TV client). mark.ts settles through settled() and imports ASK from rules. explain.ts: explain() schema gains required `value` and returns {reply, slip?, value, provider, ms}; new explainItem(item, transcript, topicId, learnerId, stillUnsure) -> {reply, slip?, settled?: Settled} records one attempt when it settles. store.ts: PracticeItem.reply?: string (kept by shown()); new event {type:'practice.settle', n, reply, verdict?, slip?, said?} - the reply always lands on item n, a verdict only if that item is still 'unsure'; 'practice.settle' is in REHYDRATE so skills refresh. Route /api/explain runs under runJob('explain', key String(item.n)), re-reads the walk after the model answers (same n, same question, same topic) before settling or dispatching, and answers {reply, slip, settled?:'right'|'wrong'}. Walk caption = it.reply ?? it.said ?? fallback. Phone keeps the ptalk block up while a reply is showing and adds 'The TV has it.'; it still shows no verdict. KNOWN GAPS, outside this write set: (a) POST /api/session dispatches any event, so a client could post practice.settle (or practice.marked, as before) with a verdict - a refusal list there would close it; (b) the history line markSet writes ('k of n right') is not updated when an explanation settles an item; (c) the operator checkout's desk/node_modules lacks @next/env, so no worktree next dev (and no Playwright TV capture) runs until it is reinstalled.
